summary: Allow exact-incarnation push erasure after pairing expiry or revocation

schema.detail: No database or wire schema change; cleanup uses the immutable pairing claim and existing bearer proof.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: Only exact push DELETE permits an expired or revoked locally-issued bearer to erase its own registration incarnation. No session, read, registration or other authority is restored. A newer same-subject pairing invalidates the old proof; another grant's registration is never deleted.

manual.detail: No upgrade step. Reconnect to the issuer to finish pending cleanup before forgetting its pairing.

recovery.detail: Cleanup remains idempotent after expiry or revocation. Unknown proofs and network, database or journal failures remain explicit failures retaining pairing credentials.
